content:
BUILT CoLAB, as the entity responsible for PPS5, organized the Demonstrator Workshops for the REV@CONSTRUCTION Mobilizing Project, which took place on 24 and 25 May in Porto and Lisbon.

The aim of these workshops was to present the activities, innovations and results obtained by each of the project’s working groups, as well as to provide detailed information on the digital tools developed during REV@CONSTRUCTION by the entities involved in the project!

To this end, the co-promoters responsible for the activities presented were present to give a detailed account of the work carried out and the main results obtained: BIMMS, IC-FEUP, LNEC, INESC TEC, IST, BUILT CoLAB, UMinho, IP, Mota-Engil, 3Maps, TDGI, Teixeira Duarte, AdF.

BUILT CoLAB was also present as a co-promoter, with João Moutinho presenting the work carried out within the scope of PAV 4.0 and Pedro Nogueira Martins presenting the work carried out within the scope of the National Object Library (idBIM 4.0).

João Poças Martins and Lurdes Laranjeira from BUILT CoLAB led the event as well as the debate and Q&A.

About REV@CONSTRUCTION

The “Digital Construction Revolution – REV@CONSTRUCTION” Mobilizing Project has as its basic principle the implementation of the Digital Transformation of companies in the AEC sector, with the aim of promoting their competitiveness and sustainable growth, as well as a strategic alignment with the sector at European level. To this end, they propose to develop and disseminate digital solutions to companies in the sector, involving everything from architects and designers to project management and construction companies. Through integrative, transversal and structuring initiatives, it aims to mobilize the AEC Sector for the DIGITAL REVOLUTION. Find out more at https://revconstruction.pt/.

This is a project co-financed by COMPETE 2020, LISBOA 2020 and Portugal 2020 and the European Union through the European Regional Development Fund.
